ladder.name: ECOSYSTEM_ONLY
ladder.stands_in: deterministic verifiers, ledger receipts, invariants, manifests, the Registry

rules.ORDER: E0 is the strongest target; a mode with fewer LLMs is a lower rung
rules.LOWEST_SUPPORTED_MODE_DECLARED: every stage, gate predicate and SV-LLM path declares lowest_supported_mode
rules.DEGRADED_FORM_PER_RUNG: an item requiring N LLMs names its degraded form at every rung below N, down to E0
rules.STAGE_EVALUATION_VS_EXIT: a stage's lowest_supported_mode is the lowest mode at which its gate evaluation terminates; exit_passable_at_e0 is true only when every exit predicate has an E0 terminal
rules.E0_TERMINAL_OR_CLASS_B: an item without e0_terminal is a class B (missing capability) gap under the owning goal; e0_terminal may be a six-field FAIL_CLOSED
rules.AT_MOST_ONE_LLM: no predicate or path may require more than one LLM (requires_llms <= 1)
rules.NO_PROVIDER_REQUIREMENT: no item may require a specific model or provider; providers are optional manifest-declared layers
rules.NO_OWNER_MUST_ACT: no terminal state or degraded form is an 'owner must act' / human-gated state
rules.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE_IS_NORMAL: provider unavailability degrades one rung and continues; it is never a blocker
rules.E0_TERMINAL_IS_EXERCISED_NOT_FLAGGED: an e0_terminal is proven: validate() executes the item's witness cases (each reaching its expected E0 terminal, at least one non-ALLOW, six fields on every non-ALLOW) or the component is pinned <org>/<repo>@<40-hex commit> and exercised by that repository's own suite; every non-final stage gate is evaluated with no evidence and must terminate
